task.title: Decide recognition-engine ownership and Audiveris suitability
task.objective: Use the Automation evidence handoff plus independent Architect research to decide whether Score2GP should consume a suitable third-party recognition object, build and own the required recognition layer, or adopt a bounded hybrid; convert the decision into explicit system requirements and a sequenced task boundary without implementing product behavior.
acceptance: The Automation handoff is recorded as reported evidence with exact provenance, hashes, commands, claims, limitations, and unresolved questions; private inputs remain local and sanitized.

The Architect independently compares Audiveris and credible third-party or owned alternatives against explicit Score2GP requirements, licensing, deployment, object/API boundary, fidelity, privacy, reproducibility, maintenance, and exit criteria.
The decision record selects third-party, owned, or hybrid ownership, records rejected alternatives and disconfirming evidence, and states what remains unproven.
The resulting requirements delta is traceable to the programme plan and yields a bounded successor task sequence; no product implementation or Audiveris deletion is authorized by this task.
Automation handoff is evidence only: it cannot choose architecture, alter requirements, or author the Architect decision.

Maximum-effort behavior continues safe partial evidence and diagnostics while preserving invalid or ambiguous status; structurally invalid input never produces a valid-success claim or package; safety and integrity contradictions fail closed.
Every successor task states input classes, observable outputs, partial/refusal behavior, allowed paths, validation commands, negative controls, provenance, and promotion dependency.
